title: Shapes and Patterns
introduction: ‘Shapes and Patterns’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects shape properties, patterns, tiling, area ideas, spatial reasoning. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
